lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Bureaucracy Prime. Every clipboard, every permit, every "please hold" in the realm — it all flows FROM here.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: So if we shut it down...

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: No, hero. We can't shut it down. We have to do something far more dangerous. We have to make it... EFFICIENT.

lines.speaker: Auditor General
lines.text: I have audited your journey. Eleven chapters of unauthorized heroism. Four unreported miracles. And one (1) pair of stolen spa slippers.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: They said I could keep the slippers.

lines.speaker: Auditor General
lines.text: NOTHING IS COMPLIMENTARY. EVERYTHING IS ITEMIZED. Prepare for FIELDWORK.
The seventeenth sub-basement. A modest desk. A person you will not remember tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Under-Under-Secretary
lines.text: You want the Department reformed. I run the Department. I have run it since before there was anything to depart FROM.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Then sign our Reform Petition! We have 40,000 signatures! Some are wolves!

lines.speaker: Under-Under-Secretary
lines.text: Petitions are processed in the order received. You are... number two. Number one has been processing since the dawn of time. Care to expedite? Expediting is COMBAT.

lines.speaker: Under-Under-Secretary
lines.text: Reform... approved. Effective... eventually.
Somewhere above, a form is eliminated. Then another. The Department weeps and streamlines, streamlines and weeps.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Two chapters left, hero. The trail of quotas leads UP. Past the org chart. Past EVERYTHING. To the Spreadsheet Dimension.
By the water cooler, the Eternal Intern reads a rice-paper pamphlet. Their eyes widen, possibly for the first time in millennia.

lines.speaker: Eternal Intern
lines.text: It says here... "exposure" is not... a currency?

lines.speaker: Fenris
lines.text: Local ∞ — the Interns' Union. Founding demand: existing counts as experience.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: He's IN the Department of Doom itself. The wolf has no fear. Only bylaws.
A grinding hum fills the corridor. Confetti drifts from a vent. The confetti was somebody's destiny.

lines.speaker: The Shredder of Fates
lines.text: FEED ME YOUR FILE. EVERYONE'S FILE ENDS HERE. CROSS-CUT. NO APPEALS.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Our file has twenty chapters of victories in it.

lines.speaker: The Shredder of Fates
lines.text: THICK FILES ARE MY FAVORITE.
The stairs to the seventeenth sub-basement. Each step is labeled with a year. The bottom steps have no numbers, only apologies.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Whoever runs the Department is down there. Every clipboard, every queue, every "please hold" — it all started with THEM.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Then that's where it ends.
